units.source_text: 二月初，宫中举行临时任官式，薰中纳言升任权大纳言，又兼右大将之职。

en.t: At the beginning of the second month, a special court appointment ceremony was held, and Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, was promoted to Provisional Major Counselor and also took on the post of Captain of the Right.

units.source_text: 这是因为红梅右大臣辞去了他所兼任的左大将之职，原来的右大将升任为左大将，因此命薰君兼任了右大将。

en.t: This was because the Minister of the Right, Kobai, had resigned from the additional post of Captain of the Left; the former Captain of the Right was promoted to Captain of the Left, and Kaoru was therefore ordered to serve concurrently as Captain of the Right.

units.source_text: 薰君升官后赴各处拜客，匂亲王处也必须一到。

en.t: After his promotion, Kaoru went around paying formal visits, and he also had to call on Prince Niou.

units.source_text: 匂亲王为了二女公子患病，此时住在二条院，薰大将就来到二条院。

en.t: Because the Second Princess was ill, Prince Niou was then staying at the Nijo residence, and General Kaoru came there to see him.

units.source_text: 匂亲王闻得他来，吃了一惊，说道：“这里有许多僧人做祈祷，应酬很不方便呢。”

en.t: When Prince Niou heard that Kaoru had arrived, he was startled and said, "There are many monks here offering prayers, so it is very inconvenient to receive visitors."

units.source_text: 只得换上新的衬衣和常礼服，整饰仪容，下阶来答拜。

en.t: He had no choice but to put on a fresh underrobe and his ordinary formal dress, compose his appearance, and come down the steps to return the visit.

units.source_text: 薰大将向匂亲王启请：“今夜即将犒赏卫府僚属，特设飨宴，务请光临。”

en.t: General Kaoru formally invited Prince Niou, saying, "Tonight I am holding a banquet to reward the officials of the guards, and I earnestly ask you to attend."

units.source_text: 匂亲王为了二女公子患病，能否出席，犹豫未决。

en.t: Because the Second Princess was ill, Prince Niou hesitated, unable to decide whether he could attend.

units.source_text: 这飨宴悉照夕雾左大臣以前的排场，在六条院举行。

en.t: The banquet was held at the Rokujo residence, following in every detail the grand style once used by Yugiri, the Minister of the Left.

units.source_text: 随从的诸亲王及高官贵族，云集殿上，其喧哗热闹不亚于夕雾升任左大臣时的飨宴。

en.t: The attending princes, high officials, and nobles gathered in great numbers in the hall, and the lively bustle was no less than at the banquet when Yugiri had been promoted to Minister of the Left.

units.source_text: 匂亲王终于也来出席，但因心挂两头，未曾终宴，匆匆告退。

en.t: Prince Niou did come in the end, but with his thoughts divided between the two places, he left hurriedly before the banquet was over.

units.source_text: 这里的六女公子听到了，说道：“太失礼了，这算什么样子呢！”

en.t: When the Sixth Princess there heard of it, she said, "How terribly rude. What kind of behavior is that?"

units.source_text: 这并非为了二女公子身份低微，只是因为左大臣声势烜赫，这女儿骄傲成性，便目空一切，惟我独尊了。

en.t: This was not because the Second Princess was of low rank, but because the Minister of the Left's power was so imposing that this daughter had grown arrogant by nature, looked down on everyone, and thought only herself important.
